status_summary: No bill, rule or order sunsetting the Office of Accountability and Whistleblower Protection was found. The office is established in statute at 38 U.S.C. 323, added by Public Law 115-41 in 2017, with no later amendments shown, and a VA whistleblower page last updated 2025-02-04 still lists it as a channel for disclosures.
title: Sunset the Office of Accountability and Whistleblower Protection
uncertainties: The statute was read on the Cornell Legal Information Institute copy because the House Law Revision Counsel page returned a not-found page. Four web searches and a Federal Register API query found no repeal bill in the period tracked; a 2022 House committee discussion draft to strip the office of retaliation investigations predates the period. A bill could exist that these searches missed.
